mapper.select: SELECT b.id AS b_id, b.document_id AS b_document_id, b.slug AS b_slug, b.status AS b_status, b.allow_visitor_download AS b_allow_visitor_download, b.published_at AS b_published_at, b.created_at AS b_created_at, b.updated_at AS b_updated_at, d.id AS d_id, d.owner_id AS d_owner_id, d.origin_type AS d_origin_type, d.revision AS d_revision, d.created_at AS d_created_at, d.updated_at AS d_updated_at, c.id AS c_id, c.document_id AS c_document_id, c.stage AS c_stage, c.title AS c_title, c.summary AS c_summary, c.content AS c_content, c.reading_time_minutes AS c_reading_time_minutes, c.updated_by AS c_updated_by, c.created_at AS c_created_at, c.updated_at AS c_updated_at FROM blog_post b JOIN document d ON d.id = b.document_id JOIN document_content c ON c.document_id = d.id AND c.stage = #{publishedStage} WHERE b.slug = #{slug} AND b.status = #{publishedStatus}
